text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, the one to cross 
the line first in the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
was Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the battle to decide the 
strongest has only just begun— The two 
vowed to face each other again at the 
Autumn Tenno Sho.
